bosses.name: Vardorvis
bosses.notes: Strength and defence move linearly from full hitpoints to none (DPS calc scaling/Vardorvis.ts). The stats file stores both as 0. Defence cannot be drained (DPS calc DefenceReduction.ts floor = current defence).

bosses.name: Araxxor
bosses.unmodelled: Enraged phase adds 35 defence, 28 magic and 31 ranged levels (DPS calc scaling/Phases.ts). The enrage is not tracked, so expected figures after it read high.

bosses.name: Yama
bosses.unmodelled: Magic defence bonus is +60 while the tank uses magic and -30 otherwise, outside phase 3 (DPS calc scaling/Phases.ts). The tank's style is not tracked.

bosses.name: Bork
bosses.unmodelled: Each phase adds magic resistance and flat armour (DPS calc scaling/Phases.ts). Phases are not tracked.
